clips.title: The story
paras: At the Undercity, you receive a crate of weapons for the Sepulcher after delivering a dispatch to the capital. Forsaken bats carry you across Lordaeron to Deathguard Podrig.

Deathguard Podrig's garrison at the Sepulcher needs a steady supply of weapons from the Undercity. In Silverpine Forest, its sentries face worgen, Dalaran remnants, and Scourge stragglers. Fresh armaments help the Forsaken hold the region and keep the outpost ready.

Bat Master Michael Garrett tends the central roost in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. Forsaken bats know the way back to the capital, but you speak with local handlers such as Karos Razok before arranging a flight to a distant outpost. Carrying Gordon's Crate across Lordaeron links the Undercity's supplies with its scattered strongholds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The bat master in the Sepulcher is Karos Razok. If you have already met him, then I can give you a bat to fly back to him.
Our bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.
You have met Karos in the Sepulcher, so you may now fly bats there. Speak with me again when you are ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, you return. Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good work, friend. These weapons will ensure our Deathguards don't get caught unprepared.
You have done a valuable service for our Dark Lady.
